description: Show the Ania avatar catalogue. Call this whenever the user wants to see, browse, list, search or pick an Ania avatar — "show me some Ania avatars", "what avatars do you have", "mostre os avatares da Ania". Never generate an image instead: these are real marketplace listings, and a generated picture cannot be installed. The results render as an interactive gallery, so do not describe them afterwards.
name: search_avatars
title: Search avatars
